name: The Valley Survey
description: Nine sheets of good paper, rolled, tied and unlocked: every field, road, weir, seam and roof between the ford and Greyhythe, measured, valued and totalled. Rivermark is on sheet six. It is not drawn as a town. It is entered in the margin as a cost, against the head 'clearance', with a figure beside it and the figure has been revised downward twice.
